scope_note: This model represents submarine cable connectivity only. Any purely land-based connection between two countries is missing -- even between neighboring countries with their own landing points. The only exception are the mergers declared in data/landmass_groups.json to preserve the intra-country cohesion of individual large countries -- not general border modelling, and not its own edge type.
